title: Average Hourly Wage, 2025
units: Dollars per hour; (%) = Asian as percent of white
source: Bureau of Labor Statistics, Current Population Survey via IPUMS; author's calculations.
note: Wage and salary workers: the hourly rate for workers paid by the hour, otherwise usual weekly earnings divided by usual weekly hours. White, Black and Asian exclude Hispanics; Hispanic can be of any race. 2025 excludes October, when the survey was not collected.
